thread:
elaine-cs: Heads-up — Aperture Labs reported rising unit cost and occasional tail latency spikes in EU after last week's traffic surge. Renewal check in ~3 weeks. I'm thinking a proactive perf play: int8 quantization for their high-volume routes, model swap (fall back to orca-mini for chat-short flows), and route-critical requests to a dedicated EU pool during peak. Anyone see major red flags?

nate-se: +1 to proactive. We should validate quality on their real prompts first. int8 usually ok but watch hallucination cases and tokenizer edge cases. Do we have sample traffic?

liang-ml: I can run a quick A/B on staging with their eval set. For int8 I'd recommend per-layer calibration and keep fp16 for responses >512 tokens or for system prompts. Will prepare a candidate quant profile.

sam-ops: Routing config sketch (canary):
```json
{"policy": "route_by_path", "routes": [{"path": "/chat", "model": "orca-mini", "weight": 0.05, "pool": "eu-dedicated"}, {"path": "/chat", "model": "redwood-llama-2-13b-qint8", "weight": 0.9, "pool": "shared-eu"}]}
```
We can bump to 25% if metrics look good.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: canary.deployment.aperture -> eu-dedicated at 1689012400 (5% for 1h). Monitorers: p95_latency, gen_quality_delta.

elaine-cs: I'll ask Aperture for ~200 representative prompts and permission for the canary. Proposed enablement call Tue 10:00 CET (they said spikes are 08:00-10:00 CET).

nate-se: Rollback criteria suggestion: revert if p95 latency regresses by >10% or gen_quality_drop >1.5% (measured on their eval set). Also track cost per 1k tokens to show economic impact for renewal.

liang-ml: Putting together an eval dashboard: baseline vs int8 vs orca-mini. Will include BLEU/ROUGE-ish metrics they currently use and a small manual spot check. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

elaine-cs: Great — assigning owners: @liang-ml for eval, @nate-se for deploy config + rollback, @sam-ops for routing/canary. I'll coordinate customer comms and capture feedback in their renewal play doc. Thanks team :thumbsup:

sam-ops: Noted. I'll also add tracing hooks so we can surface token-level lat breakdowns during the canary.

elaine-cs: Perfect. Will update thread after aperture sends prompts.
